scripts.build:base: pnpm run prepare:base && graph codegen && graph build
scripts.build:mainnet: pnpm run prepare:mainnet && graph codegen && graph build
scripts.deploy:base: bash -c 'source ../../.env && pnpm run build:base && goldsky subgraph deploy summer-dca-base/$npm_package_version --path .'
scripts.deploy:mainnet: bash -c 'source ../../.env && pnpm run build:mainnet && goldsky subgraph deploy summer-dca/$npm_package_version --path .'
scripts.deploy:all: pnpm run deploy:base && pnpm run deploy:mainnet
